name: Library TV
overview: Always-on channels from your own libraries
description: Experimental virtual television with persistent episode order, time blocks, automatic library channels, and commercial breaks. No idle encoding. Stream copy requires compatible media; compatibility encoding costs CPU.

versions.changelog: Visual channel builder with searchable show/movie selection, time blocks, commercial folders, guide preview, and optional Plugin Pages 3+ integration. Existing channel IDs and saved rotations are preserved.
Adds a separate Library TV home folder containing playable channels. Uses the same schedules and shared streams as Live TV. Experimental; validate playback transitions on your clients.
Initial experimental release. Validate channel transitions on your clients before relying on unattended playback.
